body.p: A poor man. There were many people living in the same land. One day, they were moving to a different place. They left the poor man at the tent place. They did not like their mate and usually laughed at him, always criticized him because of his louses. All his mates left, and he was left alone. He wept for a long, long time and then fell asleep. Three men approached their weak mate, put on a sack on his head and threw him into an ice hole. He does not know, how he took himself out onto the shore. He is all trembling from cold, he is hungry, he wants to sleep. So he lived like this several days in a row.[ShA:] The dual marker on sÉn is unexpected. One morning when the sun was just coming out, he heard a dog's bark and he saw a sledge with a man. He looked one time and closed his eyes. After that incident, he doesn't like people. The person who was riding the reindeer ran to him. The poor man recognized the man who was riding, they lived together earlier. Women and men recognized their mate. They whispered to each other: "This bad man was left in the old tent. Poor guy, he looks so bad. Louses are crawling on him, the clothes are torn, the boots are bad." All the people quickly did something, one brought him boots, one brought him clothing, one put the water to heat. People brought the water, washed off the louses, combed his hair. They sat him to eat and put him to bed. That day the old men and women said to their younger mates: "Never laugh, never leave your mate alone." One day, the same thing may happen to you. When your mates turn their backs to you. People's faces have changed, their eyes are looking at the ground. "We lived bad, it will not be like that anymore, it is bad to live like this." Since today, we will live well, we will help our mates when it is necessary."
